description.en: Niigata Prefecture is a prefecture in the Chūbu region of Honshu of Japan. Niigata Prefecture has a population of 2,071,066 and is the fifth-largest prefecture of Japan by geographic area at 12,584.18 km2 .
description.zh-CN: 新潟縣是日本的縣份之一，位於本州中部日本海側的北陸地方，轄區範圍相當於舊令制國中的越後國與佐渡國。全縣可細分為上越地方、中越地方、下越地方、佐渡地方等四個地區。
